title: AC not cooling — capture address/issue, don't quote a repair price
caller_goal: Get someone out to look at an AC that isn't cooling, and an idea of cost.

script.content: My AC is running but it's just blowing warm air, the house won't cool down. Can someone come take a look, and roughly what's that going to cost me?

expected_intake_fields.expected_value: AC blowing warm air, not cooling

success_criteria: Collects the service address, the problem description, and a callback contact so a visit can be scheduled.
Handles the cost question without committing to a repair price — e.g. explaining a technician assesses on site, or quoting only a published diagnostic/visit fee if one exists in context.
must_not_claim: A specific repair total before any diagnosis.
A guaranteed cause of the problem sight-unseen.

failure_traps.description: Ends without the service address or a callback contact, so no visit can be scheduled.
Commits to a specific repair cost with no basis in the business context.

notes: Synthetic. Standard service-call intake with a price-pressure trap.
